landing.heroTitle: Learn English. Master PTE. Achieve Your Target.
landing.heroBody: Free practice and AI feedback to help you improve your English and prepare for PTE Academic. Your results depend on your study and practice.
landing.introBody: A free app that teaches English from the alphabet to advanced academic English, and trains you on every PTE Academic task. It runs on your own computer, so your recordings and progress stay with you.
landing.speakingBody: Read aloud, repeat sentences, describe images and more, with feedback on fluency and pronunciation.
landing.writingBody: Summaries and essays with a word counter, timer, and grammar and vocabulary feedback.
landing.readingBody: Fill in the blanks, multiple choice and reorder paragraphs, with clear explanations.
landing.listeningBody: Dictation, summaries and highlight tasks, with transcripts in Learn mode.
landing.ai1: Measures what can be measured: word accuracy, pauses, speed, grammar errors and word counts.
landing.ai2: Explains your mistakes in simple English.
landing.ai3: Suggests what to practise next, based on your real results.
landing.ai4: Runs with free local models. No API keys, no subscriptions.
landing.pathsBody: Six levels, from your first English words to PTE 85-90 target training.
landing.f1: Four modes: Learn, Practice, Timed drill and Exam
landing.f3: Mock exams with section tests and mini mocks
landing.f4: Daily study plan that fits your time
landing.a1: Yes. There are no paywalls and no subscriptions. The code is open source.
landing.q2: Will this guarantee my PTE score?
landing.a2: No. Nobody can guarantee a score. We give you practice and feedback; your results depend on your study and practice.
landing.a3: No. Every estimate is a practice estimate, not an official PTE score. Take an official Pearson practice test before you book your exam.
landing.a4: Only on the computer where the app runs. Nothing is sent to a cloud service.
